criteria: 能说出比例的两项外项之积等于两项内项之积
能判断两个比能不能组成比例
set.description: 知道表示两个比相等的式子叫做比例，比例的两项外项之积等于两项内项之积。
set.name: Meaning and Basic Properties of Proportions
set.nameZh: 比例的意义和基本性质

set.reason: An algebraic side expression may require solving inequalities, while given numerical side lengths yield bounds by direct sums/differences. The broader solving procedure is useful preparation.
set.scope: ranges when side lengths are algebraic

set.reason: The side inequalities apply to three sides of a triangle; identifying those sides is the relevant conceptual component.
set.scope: applying side inequalities to triangle sides

set.reason: A triangle angle bisector must divide the angle into equal parts, directly using angle-bisection meaning.
set.scope: bisecting an interior angle

set.reason: The target bisects a particular triangle interior angle and meets its opposite side; these elements must be identified.
set.scope: interior angle and opposite side

set.reason: Proportional lengths use equality of ratios and its cross-product property.
set.scope: proportion definition and cross product property

set.reason: The theorem is a statement about segment ratios, and componendo-type rewriting helps when combining it with a whole side. Plain algebraic substitution achieves the same result.
set.scope: proportion manipulation when combining with whole side

set.reason: The theorem's configuration is the internal angle bisector from a vertex to the opposite side, so identifying that segment is necessary. Concurrency of the three bisectors is not needed.
set.scope: internal bisector segment meeting the opposite side

criteria: Match divided segments with their adjacent sides.
Combine the ratio with a whole-side length or another relation.
set.description: An internal triangle angle bisector divides the opposite side in the ratio of the adjacent sides; identify side correspondences before using the ratio.
set.name: Angle bisector theorem for side ratios
set.nameZh: 角平分线分边比例定理

criteria: 能判断三条线段能否构成三角形
能求第三边的取值范围
set.description: 三角形任意两边之和大于第三边，任意两边之差小于第三边（依据两点之间线段最短）。
set.name: Relationships Among the Three Sides of a Triangle

criteria: Use integrality to restrict possible values.
Find all solutions in the requested integer domain.
set.description: Solve equations subject to integer restrictions using divisibility, factor pairs, congruences, or finite bounds; justify completeness.
set.name: Integer solutions of equations

criteria: 能画出三角形的角平分线
知道三条角平分线交于一点
set.description: 三角形一个内角的平分线与对边相交，顶点与交点间的线段叫三角形的角平分线。
set.name: Angle bisectors of a triangle

criteria: 能判断线段成比例
能用比例性质变形
set.description: 四条线段 a、b、c、d 满足 a/b=c/d 叫成比例线段，掌握比例的基本性质与合比等变形。
set.name: Proportional Line Segments

criteria: 能解一元一次不等式并在数轴上表示解集
不遗漏变号
set.description: 类比一元一次方程的解法：去分母、去括号、移项、合并、系数化为 1，注意乘除负数时改变不等号方向。
set.name: Solving Linear Inequalities in One Unknown
set.nameZh: 一元一次不等式的解法

criteria: 能说出三角形的基本元素
能按边或按角对三角形分类
set.description: 认识三角形的边、角、顶点，按边（不等边、等腰、等边）和按角（锐角、直角、钝角）对三角形分类。
set.name: Concept and Classification of Triangles

criteria: 能进行角的和差与倍分运算
会用角平分线性质计算
set.description: 比较角的大小，进行角的和差运算，认识角的平分线。
